clue.text: Butcher animal and bird in America

parts.note: to butcher is to kill
a deer is an animal

explanation.surface: A hunter slaughters a beast and a bird somewhere in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: The killdeer is a North American plover named for its shrill call.

clue.text: Set the ball rolling

parts.note: the idiom for starting anything, read literally as the footballer's first touch that starts a match

explanation.surface: Someone gets a project started.
explanation.definitionFit: To start a match in football is to get play going, so the phrase also means begin anything.

clue.text: One who takes excessive interest in, say, single nurse

indicators.note: say signals that the next word is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: single means alone, lone
the nurse is a kind of shark, an example of the fish

explanation.surface: Someone shows an unhealthy interest in an unmarried nurse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Interest' looks romantic but is the charge on borrowed money; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A moneylender charging extortionate rates takes excessive interest on loans.

clue.text: Merit severe treatment under deputy head

indicators.note: in a down clue the shuffled piece sits under the leading letter
the head of the word deputy is its first letter
severe given treatment is worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: An official deserves harsh handling from the deputy head teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment' turns SEVERE into ESERVE, which goes under D, the head of 'deputy'.
explanation.definitionFit: To merit something is to be worthy of it, to have earned it.

clue.text: Clutch half-open sort of knife

indicators.note: half of the word open is taken, here its second half

parts.note: a clasp knife is one with a folding blade

explanation.surface: Someone grips a pocket knife that is partly open.
explanation.definitionFit: To enclasp is to embrace or hold tightly, a synonym of clutch as a verb.

clue.text: Prior to remain, with warning

parts.note: to be is to exist or remain
fore is the golfer's warning shout

explanation.surface: Someone is told to stay put after being cautioned beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: FORE is the shout a golfer gives to warn people a ball is coming their way.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior to means earlier than, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Promise bringing change for both later?

indicators.note: change says the letters of both later are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A promise that brings a difference for a couple later in life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bringing' and 'for' are link words; the fodder is BOTHLATER.
explanation.definitionFit: An engagement to marry is a formal pledge, a promise of marriage.

clue.text: Justifiable arrest made by policewoman?

definitions.meaning: the phrase a caught criminal concedes when nabbed fairly
humorously, an arrest by a female, the fair sex, officer

explanation.surface: A lawful arrest performed by a female officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A criminal admitting a deserved arrest calls it this; fair also hints at the fair sex.

clue.text: Pity about martyr (accepted saint)

parts.note: re means about, concerning

indicators.note: accepted means the martyr's name takes in the saint

parts.note: Sir Thomas More was a martyr executed by Henry VIII

explanation.surface: Someone feels sorry for a martyr who was later made a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Remorse in an older sense means compassion, sorrow felt for another.

clue.text: Dead linguist?

parts.note: not a linguist who has died but a scholar of dead languages such as Latin and Greek

explanation.surface: A language expert has died.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholar of Latin and Greek studies languages no longer spoken.

clue.text: Piece of verse William Brown has by heart

indicators.note: the words William Brown have the answer within them, in their middle stretch

explanation.surface: Schoolboy William Brown has learnt a poem by heart.
explanation.walkthrough: William Brown is the schoolboy hero of Richmal Crompton's Just William books.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of verse with one short syllable then one long, a metrical foot.

clue.text: Vehicle for a wide range of views

definitions.text: Vehicle for a wide range of views

parts.words: Vehicle for a wide range of views
parts.note: sounds like a forum for opinions, but means a railway carriage with large windows for scenery

explanation.surface: A medium for airing many opinions.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway carriage with big windows lets passengers enjoy the scenery.

clue.text: Provide skeleton at university, and make improper charge

parts.note: to frame is to give something its supporting structure
up means in residence at university

explanation.surface: A builder puts up a frame on campus and is accused of wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: To frame someone up is to fabricate evidence so they are falsely accused.

clue.text: Total not checked

definitions.meaning: not restrained or held back, without limits

explanation.definitionFit: Something without limits is complete in scope and also free of restraint.

clue.text: Sore patch of skin a hindrance for ornamental head-dress

parts.note: a chap is a crack or roughness on the skin
a let is a hindrance, as in without let or hindrance

explanation.surface: A rash proves awkward when wearing a decorative headpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: A wreath or garland worn on the head is a decorative headband.

clue.text: People here were relieved to hear woman's story

indicators.note: to hear says the words are spoken aloud

parts.note: a lady's myth is a woman's tale

explanation.surface: People felt relieved on hearing a woman's account.
explanation.walkthrough: Ladysmith, a town in South Africa, was besieged in the Boer War and famously relieved in 1900.
explanation.definitionFit: The town's besieged inhabitants were freed by the relief of Ladysmith.

clue.text: Get black mark after taking a dip here?

definitions.text: Get black mark after taking a dip here?

parts.words: Get black mark after taking a dip here?
parts.note: sounds like a swimmer getting a reprimand, but means a pen dipped into a pot leaves a dark mark

explanation.surface: A bather gets into trouble after a swim.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot of writing fluid into which a pen is dipped before writing.

clue.text: Absence of bird on lake is not significant

parts.note: no means none, an absence of
mina is a variant spelling of myna, the Asian starling

explanation.surface: Not seeing a bird on the lake hardly matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nominal is in name only, token, trifling.

clue.text: Spectator's greeting heard

indicators.note: heard says the greeting is spoken aloud

parts.note: wotcher is a casual London greeting, from what cheer

explanation.surface: A spectator's hello can be heard.
explanation.walkthrough: Wotcher is informal British slang for hello.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectator is an onlooker, someone who looks on.

clue.text: Sicilian, say, executed for defamation

indicators.note: executed means beheaded, so the first letter is lost

parts.note: a Sicilian is an example of an islander

explanation.surface: A Sicilian is put to death for libel.
explanation.definitionFit: A false spoken statement damaging a reputation is spoken defamation.

clue.text: Unethical lawyer, more wary when framing a good person

indicators.note: framing means the first word surrounds the second

parts.note: shyer means more timid or wary
ST, saint, is a good person

explanation.surface: A crooked lawyer, growing cautious, sets up an innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: A shyster is a disreputable, dishonest practitioner of law.

clue.text: I've reformed in desire to succeed

indicators.note: in places the reworked letters inside the word for desire

parts.note: to ache is to long or desire

indicators.note: reformed means the letters of I've are made into a new order

parts.note: taken as written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone has changed their ways in order to do well.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a reformed character; 'reformed' is the anagram signal, and 'to' is just a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To accomplish something is to succeed in it.

clue.text: Lists polluted resorts

indicators.note: polluted suggests the word resorts is corrupted into a new order

explanation.surface: A report names holiday towns spoiled by pollution.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosters are rotas, schedules naming who does what.

clue.text: Change of life-style for All Souls, say?

definitions.text: Change of life-style for All Souls, say?

parts.words: Change of life-style for All Souls, say?
parts.note: sounds like an Oxford college reforming, but describes souls passing into new bodies

explanation.surface: An Oxford college adopts a new way of living.
explanation.walkthrough: All Souls is an Oxford college; here the words mean every soul.
explanation.definitionFit: Transmigration is the passing of a spirit into a new body after death.

clue.text: Move slowly towards centre of church

parts.note: in means inward, towards the centre

explanation.surface: A worshipper creeps up the aisle to the middle of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To creep forward a little at a time is to edge.

clue.text: Conform to the rules, as those who serve do?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for obeying orders and behaving
a tennis server must put a foot right up to, not over, the baseline

explanation.surface: Tennis players keep within the regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: Placing the foot on the mark means obeying the rules exactly.

clue.text: In a state, no end flushed

indicators.note: no end means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Florida is a US state

explanation.surface: Someone in a certain state with no end is red in the face.
explanation.definitionFit: Florid means ruddy or red-faced, as one flushed.

clue.text: Sort of boy said to be in trousers

definitions.meaning: a ... buoy is a rescue seat on a rope, and buoy said aloud is boy

explanation.surface: A certain kind of boy is wearing trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: A breeches buoy is a canvas seat slung from a rope to haul people off ships; 'to be in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Breeches are short trousers fastened at the knee.
